violations.why: Only interrupt 1 is masked, so irq_kestrel can decrement v_basalt between the task's check and its reset. The reset is then based on a stale value.
Interrupts are enabled after the write in fn_tundra, so irq_kestrel can modify v_basalt before the task reads it at line 17.
irq_willow is not yet masked between line 26 and disable_isr(1), including during init(). It can change v_basalt before the task reads it at line 17.
